criteria.criterion: Accept refuses **before merging** when evidence is missing, failed, from another commit, from a dirty tree, or names fewer methods than required, with a reason naming the defect; `drop` ignores evidence.
criteria.evidence: scripts/sandcastle-accept.sh:36-41 runs `npx tsx .sandcastle/accept.mts --check …` and exits 1 before `git merge` (line 44), leaving the branch unmerged; accept.mts:175-184 asks `androidRefusal` on the close path too, so an accept cannot skip it. The defects are each a named line in android_evidence.mts:238-253 (missing file names `no android-evidence.json in …`, failed run names result+device, other commit names both SHAs, dirty tree says it proves uncommitted code, short list names the missing methods). Verify ran all of them: `no evidence refuses, naming the file it looked for`, `a failed device run refuses, naming the run and its device`, `evidence from another commit refuses, naming both commits`, `evidence from a dirty worktree refuses…`, `evidence naming fewer methods than branch requires refuses, naming the missing one`, `accept refuses an Android branch whose run left no device evidence, before the merge`, `accept lets the same branch through once its run holds passing evidence`. `grep -rn evidence .sandcastle/drop.mts scripts/sandcastle-drop.sh` returns nothing, so drop never consults the record.

concerns: This branch's own device evidence is produced by the closeout that runs after this review, so no android-evidence.json exists yet; on a host without a device (or without ANDROID_NDK_HOME/ANDROID_NDK_ROOT) the run ends `stopped: device` with the gate's own line, which the criterion allows but a human should expect to see before accepting.

The instrumented path itself (am instrument with the comma list, and a record written from a real run) was not exercised here: adb lists emulator-5554 attached, but no NDK root is exported in this environment, so `zig build android-gate` cannot reach the device. The tool binary was compiled directly and probed for the refusal and record paths instead.

android-evidence.json's required[].why is the same generic sentence (`required by this run branch`) for every method: ProjectConfig.android.gate.command (project.mts:70-72) carries only the method list, so the reasons requiredScenarios derives (added/changed, declared, smoke) never reach the record.

addedOrChangedMethods matches only added declaration lines (`+ … void name(`), so a scenario modified in its body alone is not detected and the branch falls back to the pinned smoke. That follows the issue's own design wording but is narrower than 'changed' in the criterion.
`accept.mts:13` still imports `ghTracker` without using it; that line is carried over from develop, so it is not new on this branch.
